body:
I started taking Cymbalta about a year and half ago. While at first I noticed a lot of improvement, I feel like it's working less and less.
There's been very few negatives with Cymbalta. It makes me grind my teeth at night when I'm asleep, and it isn't the cheapest drug I've ever had, even with insurance.
I never noticed any crazy feelings, and when I first went on it, it gave me stomach problems. I had better kuck not eating
with it at first. And I
shouldn't have looked for it to be a miracle. It's just a so-so drug that seems to lose effectiveness over time.
